name: c08-kirana-phone
prompt: Exactly as in the image: a small kirana shop in Hyderabad's old city at noon, the woman in the maroon saree with the mustard blouse behind the glass-fronted wooden counter reading her smartphone, shelves of colourful unbranded packets, jars of sweets, hanging sachet strips, a weighing scale, a ceiling fan, bright sun on the lane. She reads, her smile widens, she nods to herself and taps the screen with her thumb, then looks up at her shelves; the fan turns, a shopper passes outside. Locked-off camera, no movement. Sound: a turning fan, street chatter, a scooter passing, a soft phone tap. No text, no logos, no lettering anywhere. Photorealistic live action, 35 mm, natural skin and fabric.
